findings.title: Atomic financing exhaustion can issue a false impossibility certificate
findings.status: reproduced in original artifact; coordinator guard passed bounded recheck
findings.failure: The atomic graph omits legal bundled sales accepted by the unchanged engine, but check_elimination interprets graph exhaustion as impossibility for own sales and mortgages.
findings.fixture: Inventory-conserving synthetic state: cash 0; Brown houses 1/1; Dark Blue hotels 1/1; bank houses 0; another player holds 30 houses. The debtor lands on that player's Illinois Avenue with three houses, producing engine-computed rent 750.
findings.contradictory_witness: One accepted sell plan sells each Dark Blue hotel and its four replacement houses, raises 1000, pays 750, leaves 250.
findings.historical_corpus_impact: No changed historical result found. G7 d339 has no offered sell action, and an attempted bundled sale rejects before plan validation. Its sole financing edge is Oriental mortgage followed by bankruptcy.
findings.correction: Refuse negative graph certification if any expanded state offers sell_houses_or_hotel unless enumeration is complete for bundled sales.
findings.recheck: recheck_fix.py verifies the coordinator's guard refuses the counterexample, the bundled payment remains legal, G7 remains certified, and all 126 results are unchanged except graph_scope.

tested_limitations.topic: Payment predicate assumes live financing provenance
tested_limitations.result: payment_in accepts an invented same-amount BUILD debit. This does not produce a false historical witness because the runner executes only live sales/mortgages and the reviewer separately verified original debt reason/amount.

tested_limitations.topic: State key applies within one fixed debt search
tested_limitations.result: A commuting three-mortgage graph reduces 10 nonterminal paths to 7 states without changing menus or pending debt. The key does not support merging states from different debts or post-payment futures.
Bound certificates cover present-debt own sales/mortgages. G7 covers its mortgage-only legal graph. Neither covers earlier management, trades, assistance, future turns, or future survival.

additional_failures: None found in population selection within the inherited cohort, original source linkage, historical prefixes, upper-bound arithmetic, the three payment witnesses, construction purchase preservation, or the finite G7 negative certificate.
inherited_not_fresh: recorded actor/model labels before source comparison
reviewer_mutation_scope: Only files beneath round2/certificates; live artifact changes were made by coordinator and tracked separately.
